say:1:1520627001:1.text: Shoot, he slipped past us again... Now what are we gonna do?!
say:1:1520627001:1.source_cn: 可恶，怎么还是让马修跑了？！这下怎么交代？！

say:2:1520627002:1.text: And who in the name of Sarethiel are you? You just jumped in and started fighting us for no reason?!
say:2:1520627002:1.source_cn: 你们两个到底是干什么的，怎么不分青红皂白上来就打人啊！

say:4:1520627003:1.text: Wait, that girl next to him is—a Wildborn?! Form up, form up!
say:4:1520627003:1.male: Wait, that girl next to him is—a Wildborn?! Form up, form up!
say:4:1520627003:1.female: Wait, that girl next to her is—a Wildborn?! Form up, form up!

say:6:1520627004:1.text:
Stand down!
I've seen these two before. They were with General Perseus.
say:6:1520627004:1.source_cn: 停手！\n我见过这两个人，他们曾与珀尔修斯统帅同行。

say:7:1520627005:1.text: We will obey the General's wishes and treat them as guests.
say:7:1520627005:1.source_cn: 我们应当尊重统领的意见，对这两人保持友善。

choice_prompt:8:1520627005.text: We will obey the General's wishes and treat them as guests.
choice_prompt:8:1520627005.source_cn: 我们应当尊重统领的意见，对这两人保持友善。

say:9:1520627006:1.text: They were a bit impulsive, but they meant well. They were only trying to <style="highlight">protect Matthew</style> from leaving the outpost.
say:9:1520627006:1.source_cn: 他们有些冲动，但也是出于善意的无奈之举。他们是为了<s...

say:10:1520627008:1.text: It's a long story... It's because of Matthew's daughter, Keira.
say:10:1520627008:1.source_cn: 这事说来话长……是因为马修的女儿，奎莉。

say:11:1520627009:1.text: Keira was a brave soldier. Unfortunately, during the battle over Mirehold, she was a vanguard commander... and was killed by the Wildborn.
say:11:1520627009:1.source_cn: 奎莉是一位英勇的士兵。遗憾的是，在占领水泽营地的战斗里...

say:12:1520627010:1.text: The battle was so brutal, we couldn't even recover her body.
say:12:1520627010:1.source_cn: 那场战争太过惨烈，我们甚至没能替她收尸。

say:14:1520627011:1.text: That's your own fault. You shouldn't have attacked Mirehold.
say:14:1520627011:1.source_cn: 那是你们的错。你们不该进攻水泽营地。

say:15:1520627012:1.text: Be quiet, little furspawn. For the General's sake, I'll let it slide this time.
say:15:1520627012:1.source_cn: 冷静点，小兽人。看在珀尔修斯统帅的份上，我不会和你计较。

say:16:1520627013:1.text: After Keira died, Matthew... hasn't been well. He keeps trying to sneak past the outpost to the other side of the rift. We're worried he's trying to get revenge on the Wildborn and get himself killed, so we've been stopping him.
say:16:1520627013:1.source_cn: 在奎莉死后，马修的精神就出现了问题，时不时就想偷偷穿越...

say:17:1520627014:1.text: But as you saw, in his current state, he won't listen to reason. We have to use our weapons to force him back.
say:17:1520627014:1.source_cn: 但你们也看到了，以他现在的状态，不管说什么他都听不进去...

choice_prompt:18:1520627014.text: But as you saw, in his current state, he won't listen to reason. We have to use our weapons to force him back.
choice_prompt:18:1520627014.source_cn: 但你们也看到了，以他现在的状态，不管说什么他都听不进去。我们只能靠武器逼他退回去。

say:19:1520627015:1.text: It's alright. I can see you were trying to protect him.
say:19:1520627015:1.source_cn: 没关系，我看得出，你们是想保护他。

say:20:1520627016:0.text: But right now, we need to <style="highlight">find Matthew</style>. He's the only family Keira's got left...
say:20:1520627016:0.source_cn: 不过当务之急是<style=highlight>把马修...

say:22:1520627017:0.text: Adu, Wros, I'm going with them to find Matthew. I'll leave you two in charge here.
say:22:1520627017:0.source_cn: 阿多、沃斯利，我跟他们一起去找马修。你们看守好哨卡。

choice:8:0:1.text: You need to discipline these guards.
choice:8:0:1.male: You need to discipline these guards.
choice:8:0:1.female: You need to discipline these guards.

say:26:1520627007:1.text: Attack? On the contrary, they were trying to <style="highlight">protect Matthew</style> by blocking his path.
say:26:1520627007:1.source_cn: 攻击？你误会了。相反，他们是为了<style=high...
say:26:1520627007:1.male: Attack? On the contrary, they were trying to <style="highlight">protect Matthew</style> by blocking his path.
say:26:1520627007:1.female: Attack? On the contrary, they were trying to <style="highlight">protect Matthew</style> by blocking his path.

choice:8:1:2.text: Then why did they attack Matthew?
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 他们为什么要攻击马修？
choice:8:1:2.male: Then why did they attack Matthew?
choice:8:1:2.female: Then why did they attack Matthew?
